# ClientTurn

> ClientTurn is instant lead follow-up, deterministic qualification and booking software for UK B2B companies — agencies, web development and design studios, SaaS, ecommerce and professional services. It replies to Meta and Google lead-form enquiries within moments, qualifies them against rules the business configures itself, and books the next step, so no enquiry goes cold waiting for a human to notice it.

ClientTurn is built and operated by Blackwellen Limited (company number 16482166, registered in England and Wales). The product trades under the name ClientTurn; every contract is with Blackwellen Limited.

Qualification and follow-up are 100% deterministic: the same configured rules and stop conditions always produce the same outcome. An optional AI layer may classify what an inbound reply means and suggest a value for a question the business has already configured — it never composes a quote, a promise, availability or a service commitment, and anything low-confidence or unmatched is handed to a person. Follow-up always respects opt-outs, quiet hours and per-contact attempt limits, re-checked immediately before every send.

## What it does

- Connects to Meta Lead Ads and Google lead forms and responds to new leads within seconds of submission.
- Runs a configurable follow-up sequence across SMS, WhatsApp and email until the lead replies, books, or opts out.
- Qualifies replies against rules and questions the business defines — deterministic, not a language model guessing.
- Books the next step directly into Google Calendar or Calendly.
- Sources and verifies new prospects for outbound (Companies House-verifiable UK businesses; email-only cold outreach — no purchased phone data), for teams that also want to build pipeline, not just respond to it.
- Reactivates past enquiries that never converted, respecting opt-outs and lawful basis.
- Reports on source, follow-up and reactivation performance in one dashboard, and full pipeline attribution from first touch to won.
- Connects to HubSpot, Zoho and Salesforce, and accepts inbound leads from Pipedrive, folk and others via a signed webhook endpoint.
